title: Lightning protection systems: installation, alteration and addition under the building and electrical disciplines
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document; also cites the 2024 Canadian Electrical Code Part I
document_date: Date Issued: April 2025 (platform created April 15, 2025, last updated April 15, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies requirements for installing, altering or adding to lightning protection systems for building owners, designers, electricians and SCOs.
Sentence 3.6.1.3.(1) of NBC(AE) requires lightning protection systems to conform to the CSA lightning installation code.
Rule 10-108 (Appendix B) of the 2024 Canadian Electrical Code lists the CSA-B72 standard as a recommended practice.
An electrical permit is required to install, alter or add to an electrical system.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
The cited CSA B72 standard and the CE Code are not in the package. Joint Building/Electrical interpretation.
